name: Nabuchodonosor
description: King of the Assyrians, reigning in Nineve; warred against and destroyed Arphaxad king of the Medes; when the nations of the west made light of his commandment he sware by his throne and kingdom to be avenged upon them, called Holofernes his chief captain and sent him forth with his army to subdue the whole earth and make every nation worship Nabuchodonosor only as god

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
